metadata.purpose: Reduce account-takeover risk by requiring multifactor authentication for interactive access by ordinary lab users and lab administrators.
metadata.scope: The shared LAB_USERS_GROUP_ID and LAB_ADMINS_GROUP_ID groups, for all cloud apps and all client app types.
metadata.exclusions: The shared emergency-access group and the named, time-bounded MFA exception group.
prerequisites: Microsoft Entra ID P1 or qualifying suite licences for in-scope users
Pilot users have registered usable MFA methods
Emergency-access accounts exist, are independently secured, monitored, and tested
Group object IDs have been reconciled with the Enterprise Identity Governance Lab
metadata.expectedUserImpact: Users without an MFA claim are prompted to complete MFA; existing valid MFA claims can satisfy the control. Report-only mode records the predicted result and does not prompt or block.
metadata.owner: Zero Trust Identity & Conditional Access Lab
